text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She met all expectations! Claiming a 
magnificent victory, it's Orfevre--!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Ha, hahahahaha...! Ah, yes... of course!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Accept it! Behold the majesty of the King!

text_block_list.name: Orfe Fan
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, it didn't work...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I worked so hard, really, really hard...! 
And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...I knew it—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation! Great work out there!! Nice 
run!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to next time! Thanks 
for showing us such a great race!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...! Please watch 
me... next time too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't able to claim victory at the 
Nippon Derby— but the cheers embracing Win 
Variation were warm and gentle.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It didn't work out. ...But there were 
people watching me."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It's definitely reaching them. I know I'm 
getting closer."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(If I just keep working hard and moving 
forward together with Trainer like this—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Someday, I might surpass Orfevre and 
become the leading star... maybe.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! I have to try my best. More and more, 
even more...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best together in our next 
target race, the Kikuka Sho, too! I'm 
counting on you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next was the Kikuka Sho, the final leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown. Days of rushing 
toward the big autumn stage had begun.
